description: Seznam avtobusnih postajališč v občini Krško is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KRŠKO. The collection shows the locations where bus stops are located in the city centre of Krško. Coverage: OBČINA KRŠKO. The portal shows the English title as "List of bus stops in Krško" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA KRŠKO. Its keywords include občina Krško, avtobusne postajališča. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
